content: RLS policies split USING (read/delete visibility) and WITH CHECK (write validation); UPDATE policies need both. For a profiles-table-based permission check (project's mandated pattern per CLAUDE.md), policies on OTHER tables (packages, package_photos, etc.) can safely subquery profiles inline -- recursion only bites when a table's own RLS policy queries itself. But if profiles' own policies ever need self-referential admin checks, use a SECURITY DEFINER plpgsql function (see recursion pitfall) not a plain SQL function (inlined by the planner, losing SECURITY DEFINER context).
